overall: The AG found the Masconomet Regional School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by adopting insufficiently detailed minutes of its August 28 retreat, but the violation was not intentional; an ADA subcommittee allegation was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes of the August 28 retreat-meeting were not sufficiently detailed, lacking summaries of the discussions held.
allegations.key_passage: As originally drafted and approved on September 11, the minutes of the August 28 meeting were not sufficiently detailed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the violation was intentional, claiming members deliberately took inadequate notes and chose not to record the meeting to evade specificity requirements.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the violation was not intentional.

allegations.summary: Complainant's request for review raised that subcommittee meetings are held in a non-ADA-accessible basement room, an allegation not in the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review any allegation not raised in the complaint filed with the Committee.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of the letter, amend the minutes of the August 28 meeting to substantively and accurately summarize the discussions held on each topic, and certify to the AG that it has done so.
remedy_passage: We additionally order the Committee, within 30 days of the date of this letter, to amend the minutes of its August 28 meeting to substantively and accurately summarize the discussions held on each topic and to certify to our office that it has done so.
